scope: Prime n83 m3-9; three existing factor-base arms, retained planted/natural and explicitly synthetic centered/adjacent targets

raw_layout.instrument: Exact digest-pinned native generator/replayer copied from the task image
raw_layout.host.txt: Kernel/CPU metadata; no performance timing claim
raw_layout.source/: Native source, dependencies, lockfile, controller and design snapshots
raw_layout.prepared/index.json: 84 exact input identities, parent/effective source hashes, target origin and base hash
raw_layout.prepared/KEY.json: Normalized arithmetic input plus exact embedded parent bytes, effective source, transform and provenance
raw_layout.results/KEY/input.json: Byte-identical canonical prepared input, checked before replay
raw_layout.results/KEY/A0.poly,A1.poly,A2.poly: P and centered quotient normal forms of XP and X^2P
raw_layout.results/KEY/certificate.json: Exact degrees, counts, alternating projection, formula checks and source binding
raw_layout.results/KEY/manifest.json: Native payload hashes excluding this per-case manifest
raw_layout.producer-rows.jsonl,replay-rows.jsonl: One observation per successfully completed case and phase
raw_layout.terminal.json: Whole worker exit, timestamps, backend and phase statuses
raw_layout.manifest.sha256: All final raw payload hashes, excluding files named manifest.sha256

codec: CENTERED_WITNESS_FORMAT.json defines N83CEN1 bytes and the centered quotient
failure_semantics: Only successfully generated/replayed case rows establish those checks. Partial uploads and absent rows remain incomplete; all failures and original attempts are retained.
target_semantics: synthetic_centered_control and synthetic_adjacent_control have no asserted rational target lift. The legacy effective target_kind=natural means non-planted source only; target_origin gives the actual origin.
degree_semantics: Remainder degree includes unrestricted U. Exact LFD and regularity remain null in arithmetic certificates.

statuses.partial: Case directory exists but required payloads or identity checks are incomplete/invalid
statuses.payload_hashes_verified: Required payload hashes and frozen input identity checked; arithmetic not recomputed

collection.native_replay_verified: Always false in this metadata collector; native verify output is separate evidence
collection.write_policy: Fresh output only; raw files untouched
